comments.body:
To re-iterate, the choice was between:

(i) run on different hw - making the scores not comparable between submissions, because they're not computed with the same ground truth video
(ii) run on the same hw - making the score comparable

I chose (ii) which degraded a bunch of submissions, the top 3 submissions were already very close, so there was a shake-up. 

Would you like to renounce your 3rd place?
comments.title: hnerv_lc_ac submission (0.19)

comments.body:
re: renouncing your 3rd place.

I'm asking that because it seems that you're not willing to have a productive discussion about the evaluation score in the open :) I'm happy to be proven wrong, or re-evaluate my trade-offs, but trying to influence things privately is not the way to do so :) 

If you read the scores as a black box number, then I agree that each solution gets to pick the runtime and optimizes w.r.t. that runtime and gets scored. But the score has a physical meaning that depends on the ground truth video, so having that be mismatched makes things non comparable 100%. One way to fix this is to make the score relative to a baseline computed on the solution runtime. Maybe for the next phase, or maybe we'll just do one runtime.

re: breakthrough open solutions.

@AaronLeslie138 and other folks are getting prizes for sharing their code and being fair game :)

- this write up only reports on 4 negative experiments
- all the experiments only used the off-the-shelf trained HNeRV model with no further changes, besides 3.3 which tried to distilled it
- the fact that these 4 experiments did not improve the score does not mean that the "The comma video-compression leaderboard's top cluster (0.192–0.199) is a genuinely *saturated Pareto frontier*"

Given this: 
- I am happy to merge the write-up as a negative experiment report, but only if you fix the conclusion
- No need to have the code here but the description of the experiments have to be improved
- The best write-up award has already been awarded to #95

Closing for now until further updates.
